The '''Breta Yaga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]], which was part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained [[Breta Yaga]], an astronomical object that was the origin point of several pieces of art known as [[Flatsculp/Legends|flatsculps]], created by a [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="FieldReport" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Breta Yaga system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
